summary: Custom execution environment build steps: prepend_base adds pip.conf, removes ubi.repo and installs the hub CA with update-ca-trust, prepend_galaxy adds ansible.cfg; ansible.cfg points [galaxy] server_list at the private hub, pip.conf sets index-url and trusted-host for a PyPI mirror, and an optional custom.repo serves RPMs for bindep.txt.
questions: How do I make ansible-builder use my private automation hub?
How do I point an execution environment build at a PyPI mirror?
How do I trust the hub CA certificate in an EE build?
How do I use a custom RPM repo in ansible-builder?
